extension.description: Play all your media from Google Drive including Videos, Music and Pictures. - Unlimited number of accounts. - Team Drives support - Search over your drive. - Auto-Refreshed slideshow. - Export your videos to your library (.strm files) - Use Google Drive as a source in Kodi's file manager. - This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Google.
extension.summary: כונן Google Drive של מיקרוסופט עבור קודי
extension.description: הפעל את כל המדיה שלך מ- Google Drive כולל וידאו, מוסיקה ותמונות. - מספר בלתי מוגבל של חשבונות. - חיפוש ומציאת הכונן שלך. - ריענון מצגת אוטומטית. - ייצוא קטעי הווידאו לספרייה שלך (קבצי .strm) - תוכנית זו אינה קשורה או ממומנת על ידי Google.

Spela upp alla dina medier från Google Drive, inklusive videor, musik och bilder. - Obegränsat antal konton. - Stöd för Team Drives - Sök i din Drive. - Automatiskt uppdaterat bildspel. - Exportera dina videor till biblioteket (.strm-filer) - Använd Google Drive som källa i Kodis filhanterare. - Detta program är inte anslutet till eller sponsrat av Google.
extension.news:
v1.6.12 released Oct 31, 2026: - Videos show the plot, cast and artwork of the Kodi .nfo files and pictures next to them (it can be turned off in the settings) (#301) - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.18
v1.6.11 released Oct 30, 2026: - Subtitles are found by listing the video's folder: Google's name search missed some names, like ones with "•"
v1.6.10 released Oct 30, 2026: - Big folders open a page at a time: Items per page in the Advanced settings (500 by default, 0 for the whole folder) - Going back to a folder, after viewing a picture for example, doesn't load it again for a few minutes (Cache expiration time) - Subtitles: another video's (Movie 2.srt for Movie.mkv) and trashed ones are no longer loaded; .vtt subtitles are - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.13
v1.6.9 released Oct 30, 2026: - Shortcuts to folders in shared drives show their files, also in Use as a source and in library exports
v1.6.8 released Oct 24, 2026: - Removing an account can also revoke the add-on's access to your Google account - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.10
v1.6.7 released Oct 16, 2026: - Use Google Drive as a source in Kodi's file manager works again - Requires clouddrive.common 1.5.7
v1.6.6 released Oct 16, 2026: - Faster exports now come from clouddrive.common 1.5.6 (required)
v1.6.5 released Oct 15, 2026: - Much faster exports to the library: a folder tree is listed in a few requests instead of one per folder (thanks to 0o120) - Swedish translation (thanks to Daniel Nylander)
extension.disclaimer:
This cloud drive addon uses a third-party authentication mechanism commonly known as OAuth 2.0. If you want to know more about OAuth 2.0 you can visit the following pages: - https://oauth.net/2/ - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/OAuth2 - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/developer/rest-api/getting-started/msa-oauth
Kodi and myself take no responsibility or liability.
The authentication server URL is specified in Settings / Advanced / Sign-in Server. The Sign-in Server implements the OAuth 2.0 protocol. The complete source code of the Sign-in Server can be download here: https://github.com/cguZZman/drive-login You can clone the project and host it in your own server.
